ModMetaData.name: RimSynapse - Psychology
ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.7.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Psychology Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Psychology/wiki
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Requires RimSynapse - Core. Brings your colonists to life by giving them evolving memories, complex interpersonal trust, therapeutic sessions, and trauma responses.
--- Current Features --- - Dynamic Personality Traits: The 24-hour psychological evaluation tracks profound life events. Pawns can dynamically gain or lose RimWorld traits (such as gaining Bloodlust after a brutal raid, or losing Kind) based on LLM analysis of their rolling short-term memory. - Trust and Familiarity System: Replaces vanilla's rigid opinion system with dynamic Trust (-100 to 100) and Familiarity (0 to 100) values. Vanilla OpinionOf is scaled down by 50%, with the custom Trust metric contributing the remaining 50% weight. - PTSD and Suicidal Breaks: Pawns suffering severe trauma can experience extreme mental breaks: they may enter a "Trauma Trigger" break (blindly firing at doors, walls, or loud noises before cowering) or attempt a lethal "Suicide/Self-Harm" break using their equipped primary weapon to target critical organs with a 5x damage multiplier. - Therapy and Consoling: Right-click target pawns to initiate a Therapy Session. The therapist and patient will sit together and dynamically converse via the background LLM engine. Successful sessions have a dynamic chance (influenced by mood) to permanently cure/remove severe negative and psychological traits (including PTSD, Depressive, Volatile, Nervous, Psychopath, and Bloodlust - unless locked by their backstory). - Opportunistic Euphoria: Pawns who maintain an extremely high mood (>90%) for a sustained 24 in-game hours will automatically generate a positive core memory. - Ritual Remarks: Colonists pull from their LLM relationship memories to deliver personalized Vows during marriages and Eulogies during funerals. - Forced Psychological Reviews: Demand an immediate clinical evaluation of the pawn's mental state from the LLM via the new Social Network tab. - World VIP Backstories: Faction Leaders are no longer generic. They generate with a rich, ideologically consistent history and personality profile.
--- Planned Upcoming Features --- - Couples Counseling and Dynamic Romance: Breakups and romances driven entirely by shared memories and psychological compatibility rather than RNG. - LLM-Generated Phobias: Pawns who suffer specific traumas (e.g., severe burns, insectoid attacks) may develop targeted phobias that alter their pathing and combat behavior. - Group Therapy: Let your highest-social pawn lead group sessions to mass-resolve colony-wide trauma after devastating events. - Psychological Addictions: Pawns may turn to specific drugs as a coping mechanism for specific negative memories.
--- Roadmap --- 0.8 - Demographics, News and Narrative Voice: Nightly clinical reviews moved onto Core's shared deadline batch, a backstory-arrival memory contract, and context hooks that let other modules and faction leaders read a colonist's psychology. 0.9 - Factions and Living Societies: Living social dynamics - colony cliques and a rumour mill, familiarity-milestone events, a trait-history timeline and social-network view, and auto-running therapy sessions (with Conversations). 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: Another pass over how psychology feeds factions, news and narration across the suite. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.7.0) - Regions and Territories Compatibility --- - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Psychology/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates memories of nobility and royal power. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates crises of faith and spiritual rebirth memories. Required for deep Faction Leader generation. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates genetic dysphoria and vat-grown trauma. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Integrates void taint and cosmic horror PTSD. - RimSynapse - Factions: Compatible and Optional. Empowers world generation to build deep psychological profiles and traits for Faction Leaders. - RimSynapse - Chat: Compatible and Optional. Colonists' generated dialogue will be directly influenced by their current Trust levels, Familiarity, and accumulated traumas. - RimSynapse - WorldNews: Compatible and Optional. Prints gossip and news articles about your pawns' most dramatic psychological events and relationships.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
